tasks.check: deno fmt --check . && deno lint . && deno check main.ts parse.ts
tasks.start: npm install --silent && npx vite build --logLevel error && deno run -A main.ts
tasks.desktop: npx vite build && deno desktop -A --icon icons/forest.icns --include dist --output Forest.app main.ts
tasks.pre-commit: deno task check && deno task test
tasks.pre-push: deno task check && deno task test
